framing: virtual screening with a generative front end: the generator is NOT conditioned on the binding site; the pocket enters only as a docking filter

null.construction: 391 generated molecules not in the docked subset, scored against the same corpus. The docked subset was taken by list position rather than by fit, so this null asks whether a query beats a TYPICAL generated molecule -- not whether the pocket chose it. See docking_signal.

docking_signal.question: does a better Vina score go with similarity to known binders?
docking_signal.note: Vina scores are negative-is-better, so a NEGATIVE rho means better docking goes with greater similarity to known binders

caveats: The generator is unconditioned; any pocket relevance comes from the docking filter, not from generation.
A nearest neighbour exists for every molecule by construction. Only the null percentile distinguishes a real resemblance from the background rate of the 4,099-molecule library.
Tanimoto similarity is not affinity and implies nothing about binding.
